description: Where visits to your RankControl articles came from in the last 7, 30 or 90 days (default 30), from RankControl's own page analytics, most page views first: each source (organic, ai_referral, direct, social, email or other) with its pageViews, visitors and percentage (its share of page views). Null, with a hint, until the Analytics screen is turned on (activate_analytics_screen). For the whole site from Google Analytics, use get_traffic_overview with scope "site".
name: get_traffic_sources
